comment: HTTP 429 carrying Retry-After as an HTTP-date (RFC 7231 IMF-fixdate), the second legal form Req 23.8 names -- 'Tue, 01 Jul 2026 00:05:00 GMT'. The metrics collector must parse this into a wait duration relative to when the response was received rather than rejecting it as unparseable just because it is not a bare integer; a test replaying this fixture supplies its own notion of 'now' (or asserts only that the collector attempted to parse it as a date, not as seconds) rather than this file asserting a real wall-clock wait.
